caveat: Entity-level SOC statement lines for Forestry Corporation of NSW only. notes: Latest Forestry Corporation of NSW annual report discovered from the official annual-report page (no hard-coded PDF URL) and archived with SHA-256 outside the repo. The statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income prints an explicit $'000 unit. Total expenses is the explicit printed subtotal and is accepted only when the four printed expense lines, Note 5 Other income, Note 8 Other operating expenses, Note 9 Employee benefits, Note 10 Finance costs and the profit-before-tax/net-result bridges reconcile exactly. Every row is a provisional, unverified entity-level SOC statement line (jurisdiction_level=soc, aggregation_role=agency_detail); never add Forestry Corporation rows to government program spending, the PNFC benchmark, or any other SOC.
